julien f
4 contributions

Freshness and finesse: Japan arrives on the Perfume River
Aug 2026 • Family
Very beautiful experience at Shino Sushi. We were welcomed by an amazing team, very smiling, and very efficient, attentive despite the crowd. We were not at all disappointed when the dishes arrived on the table: they were each better than the last. The sushi is delicious. But the rest of the menu is also very interesting. Special dedication to the hot oysters and the tataki dishes. In short, very, very good, and for a value that seemed unbeatable to us (but we are European). Very nice experience, thank you Loan!
